description: List this tenant's recent runs, newest first, optionally filtered by tool, status (queued|running|done|error|timeout|cancelled) or trigger (call|job|schedule|event|chain).

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

tool.description: Only runs of this tool name.

trigger.description: Only runs of this trigger kind.

name: host.runs.list
